commit_scope: Activate the isolated observer and keep deployment grounding, liveness, cold-start work, and telemetry secrets outside the serving API failure boundary.

task_card.goal: Restore Hati's Sheet-backed API path and prevent deployment maintenance or deep health probes from withdrawing the serving API again.
done_when: Docker liveness uses the lightweight ping route and eager startup cache warming is disabled by file-backed configuration.
Substrate bootstrap, RAG heal, and grounded verification run only in resource-bounded disposable sidecars.
Observer caller and OIDC policy pin permanent merge 60755fe1389c495a9eafbc71c78af1816e9c8530 and production plus authenticated Hati verification pass.
commands: cd api && .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_api_dockerfile_contract.py tests/test_runtime_mode_and_events.py tests/test_deployment_observer_oidc.py tests/test_form_cli_grounding_runtime.py
constraints: Keep full health and native witness proof fail-closed while separating them from Docker liveness.
Keep configuration file-backed and deployment maintenance resource-bounded.
Do not expose household or deployment secrets.

evidence_refs: Hostinger recovery run 38063352519 rebuilt the target successfully but marked the API unhealthy because deep health requests exceeded the five-second Docker probe timeout.
Direct VPS observation showed the API process running, an orphaned whole-body RAG heal consuming the serving container, and multiple timed-out deep health probes overlapping.
The existing /api/ping route is a data-independent event-loop liveness signal; /api/health remains the deep release and witness contract.
Slow-request telemetry retained raw secret-bearing query values, so this repair redacts them before both persistence and logs.
Permanent observer merge 60755fe1389c495a9eafbc71c78af1816e9c8530 isolates final witness verification and refreshes only its dynamic witness.
No household token, balance, transaction row, Sheet secret, SSH material, or private URL is present in this evidence.
